figurative_meaning_en: A senseless or foolish person, often used as an insult
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গেঁয়ো ভূতের মতো কথা বলে, কিছুই বোঝে না।
এই গেঁয়ো ভূতকে কে শিক্ষা দেবে?
example_sentences_in_english: He talks like a village ghost, understanding nothing.
Who will teach this clueless bumpkin?
note: Refers to ignorant rural folklore elements in Bengali culture
